verdict.rationale: FreshBooks is accounting software, so a month-end close checklist is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence shows only adjacent features: automated bank reconciliation, journal entries, and accountant access to the books. Nothing documents a close checklist that tracks reconciliations, accruals, or review sign-offs.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can run a month-end close against a checklist that tracks reconciliations, accruals, and review sign-offs
